description: Operate a deployed Progressive CMS instance: discovery, health, config, extensions, providers, maintenance, updates and diagnostics through the CLI golden path — without reading source code and without hand-editing the database.
entry_workflow: bootstrap/discovery (cms agent bootstrap --json; record environment, contracts, capabilities)
cms doctor — runtime, config, DB head/pending/drift, paths, secret store
cms capabilities --json — feature and provider inventory
config: resolve via --config / $PCMS_CONFIG_FILE / ./config/pcms.json (never guess a path)
health: GET /system/status + /system/metrics; investigate anything not fresh
extensions: cms extensions list --json; settings through GET/PUT /extensions/{id}/config + write-only secret slots
public extension routes: inspect deployed trusted-catalog membership; GET/PUT /api/v1/extensions/{id}/mount; no unmount endpoint
public extension mutations: JSON Content-Type, server-issued pcms_guest cookie, optional Idempotency-Key and same-origin checks
providers: registry via GET /media/providers; network/proxy from the manifest config_schema (no hardcoded proxies); POST /media/providers/{id}/test
maintenance: GET/PUT /maintenance — CLI requires --environment <env> --yes; every toggle is audited
updates: cms registry status/releases, then apply an explicit published version; poll /api/v1/registry/update-status; staged manifests use cms update check/apply
diagnostics: journalctl units, cms doctor again; typed error codes first, source reading last
